note: BUNDLED FALLBACK. This file ships inside the APK so that a first run with no connectivity still shows the user what exists; it is expected to be refreshed from the documentation site without a full app update, and the refreshed copy overlays this one rather than replacing the need for it. Every entry below has "verified": false, which means a maintainer has NOT confirmed it against the live repository. Repository ids and filename conventions were written from each publisher's established naming; sizes, SHA-256 hashes and commit revisions were deliberately left null rather than guessed, because a wrong hash presents to the user as a corrupted download. Before an entry is marked verified, fill in sizeBytes and sha256 from https://huggingface.co/api/models/<repo>/tree/<sha>?recursive=1 (LFS entries carry size and oid, where oid is the SHA-256) and replace revision "main" with that commit SHA. See docs/models/catalog.md.
